breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the standard formula for a uniformly distributed load (δ_w = 5wL⁴/384EI) rather than replacing the distributed load with its resultant acting at midspan. It properly treats the UDL as a distributed load case and applies the correct deflection formula, which matches the ground truth approach.
